name: Profound
description: Access all of your Profound data: visibility, citations, and AI bot traffic directly from Claude. Build automated reports, alerts, and other workflows to power your marketing data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Profound to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Profound to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.tryprofound.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Profound MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Profound provides these MCP tools: search_docs and execute.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Profound?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Profound in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Profound requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Profound is developed by Profound. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
